benefits.title: Why Alma Serena?
benefits.intro: We're looking for people who enjoy caring for others. At Alma Serena you'll find a warm team, respectful schedules and room to keep learning.

treatments.title: Treatments for you

massage-therapist.title: Massage therapist
massage-therapist.schedule: Tuesday to Saturday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
massage-therapist.summary: You'll give relaxing, deep-tissue and hot stone massages, tailoring each session to what the guest needs that day.
responsibilities: Run the short welcome consultation before each session
Deliver menu massages with the right technique and pressure
Prepare and reset the treatment room between sessions
Log notes and recommendations in each client's file
requirements: Massage therapy certification or a related technical degree
At least 2 years of experience in a spa or hotel
Nice to have: hot stone or reflexology experience

cosmetologist.title: Facial cosmetologist
cosmetologist.schedule: Thursday to Sunday, 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM
cosmetologist.summary: You'll run our facials, from assessing the skin to recommending an at-home care routine.
responsibilities: Assess each client's skin type and condition
Perform hydrating, anti-aging and deep-cleansing facials
Recommend care routines using our product line
Keep track of the facial room's inventory
requirements: A degree or technical diploma in cosmetology
At least 1 year of hands-on treatment experience
Knowledge of cosmetic actives and basic devices

front-desk.title: Front desk and guest services
front-desk.schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
front-desk.summary: You'll be the first face of Alma Serena: welcoming every guest, managing the schedule and keeping each visit flowing unhurried.
responsibilities: Welcome guests and guide them to the locker rooms and lounges
Handle bookings by phone, WhatsApp and the online system
Take payments and close out the register each day
Answer questions about treatments, packages and gift cards
requirements: Experience in customer service or reception
Comfortable with computers and digital calendars
Nice to have: conversational Spanish and English
